source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U22: Distinguish board powers,shareholder restrictions and borrowing authority

payload.title: A signature mandate is not the whole borrowing approval
payload.core_explanation_md:
Board powers must be read with the Act, constitution, reserved meeting matters and permitted delegation. Where section 180 applies, borrowing beyond the specified aggregate requires the company special resolution with a total borrowing limit. The primary text includes paid-up share capital, free reserves and securities premium, and a qualified exclusion for temporary ordinary-course banker loans. A short repayment period alone does not make capital-expenditure borrowing an excluded temporary loan.

Disposal of an undertaking and other reserved matters have their own tests. Company-class exemptions must be verified before applying them. Charitable contributions belong to the separate section 181 rule, not a copied legacy section 293 monetary floor. Preserve the resolution scope, existing borrowings, proposed borrowing and classification evidence.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a short tenor alone establish the temporary-loan exclusion?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Purpose and the full statutory definition matter.

payload.stem_md: A short-term bank loan finances capital expenditure, and a note excludes it solely because it matures within six months. Which fact matters?

options.explanation_md: The title does not settle the exception.

options.text_md: The capital-expenditure exclusion from the temporary-loan definition
Whether the bank uses digital signatures
options.explanation_md: That is unrelated to the borrowing threshold.
It has no effect on classification.

payload.stem_md: An authorised signatory can sign cheques, and the bank assumes this proves every required borrowing approval. What is missing?

options.text_md: A rule that all cheque mandates include unlimited borrowing

options.explanation_md: It does not establish company approval.

options.text_md: The applicable capacity, board/member approval and delegation trail
options.explanation_md: Signing authority does not replace all transaction approvals.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Signing authority does not replace all transaction approvals.
